description: This file defines the ClaimEventDecorator class which wraps and extends functionality around the ClaimEvent entity, providing methods to manipulate and access claim event data, including associating a user by ID.

classes.name: ClaimEventDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that encapsulates a ClaimEvent entity and provides additional methods to interact with the claim event data, including setting associated User by user ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a ClaimEvent entity.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the associated User of the ClaimEvent by the user's ID.
